nodes.question: How were areas characterized by poor or good quality of groundwater identified for efficient management decisions?
nodes.answer: The areas characterized by poor or good quality of groundwater were identified using SVM, RF, and BRT to aid in efficient management decisions and prevent the reduction of groundwater quality for various applications in the future.
